evidence_excerpts: Across 73 benchmarks, tiny program SPMs reduce WCET to 92.6% of the no-SPM WCET, and SPMs large enough for entire benchmarks reach 60% of original WCET; average code size increases by 0.02%.
text: ILP-based code scratchpad allocation lowers WCET by moving beneficial basic-block regions into fast program scratchpad memory with negligible code-size and solver overhead.
